# Platform tooling overview

A map of the tools the platform team uses and where each is documented.

## Bastion host

The bastion host is the only machine with access to the control plane. Log in with your own key.

## Job runner

The job runner runs scheduled jobs: backups, cleanups, rotations. Jobs are defined in the jobs repository.

## Dashboards

The dashboards show cluster health, queue depth and error rates.

## Wiki

The wiki holds runbooks, handover notes and architecture pages. Search it before asking in the channel.
